pairs.subject: docs-sync
pairs.evidence: scripts/build-sidecar.py:197 Commit 078fba5c (2026-10-23) made the build refuse to run without the voice-fx extra and updated the script's docstring and ADR 0138, but not apps/desktop/SIDECAR.md. Its Build block (lines 96-97) still says `uv sync --extra build` then `uv run python scripts/build-sidecar.py`, so a reader who pastes the documented steps gets this refusal.

techniques.evidence: scripts/build-sidecar.py:197 The change that added the numpy refusal (078fba5c touched build-sidecar.py and docs/adr/0138 only) did not update SIDECAR.md's Build section. Nothing at the change boundary flagged the missed document.

scripts/build-sidecar.py:3 The change was settled one surface at a time: the script's own docstring and ADR 0138 carry the new command, but the shell's sidecar guide (SIDECAR.md:96) still carries the old one. No inventory names SIDECAR.md as a surface this script owes.

scripts/build-sidecar.py:1 The coupling lives only in a docstring and points at README §3.1 'Layers', which never mentions the frozen sidecar, PyInstaller or the build. The document that actually describes this script, apps/desktop/SIDECAR.md, is not named. sidecar_entry.py:1 makes the same README §3.1 pointer.

scripts/build-sidecar.py:190 The build command is copied word for word in the docstring (line 3), two printed hints (lines 190 and 198) and SIDECAR.md:96. No copy is named as the authority and nothing compares the copies, so the SIDECAR.md copy went stale. A plain grep could have caught it.

scripts/build-sidecar.py:271 The setup and smoke instructions this program prints use safe forms. The credential is passed as a file path, not a positional token, and the install line names only the project's own extras. No prose gate scans these printed lines, but nothing in them is unsafe.
